x-m-e6-07.title: Ka Mmiri ara ehi Strawberry Nọgide n’Otu Ụtọ Mgbe A Na-emekwu
x-m-e6-07.goal: Jiri data lelee na ịgbakwunye otu ọnụ ọgụgụ na-agbanwe ụtọ, dozie mkpebi gị site n’iji nha nhata oke na-edobe oke otu.
x-m-e6-07.material: Suyeon ji iko strawberry 3 na iko mmiri ara ehi 2 mee mmiri ara ehi strawberry, ụtọ ya dabara. Ọ chọrọ imekwu nke otu ụtọ ahụ, Suyeon chere, “Ọ bụrụ na m tinye iko strawberry 3 ọzọ, m ga-etinyekwa iko mmiri ara ehi 3 ọzọ.”
x-m-e6-07.thinking.0: Iji data ọhụrụ dozie echiche mbụ gị
x-m-e6-07.thinking.1: Lelee ma uru oke ndị ahụ hà nhata
x-m-e6-07.prereq.0: Ihe oke pụtara na uru oke
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.prompt: A na-ekpughe data otu otu. Oge ọ bụla, họrọ ihe i chere.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.hint.0: N’usoro nke ọ bụla, dee oke strawberry na mmiri ara ehi n’otu ụzọ, tụnyere.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.hint.1: Kewaa mgbe i chere “ugboro ole” na mgbe i chere “iko ole ọzọ.”
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.0.info: Suyeon jiri usoro ya mee ya na iko strawberry 6 (agbakwunyere iko 3) na iko mmiri ara ehi 5 (agbakwunyere iko 3), ụtọ mmiri ara ehi siri ike karịa nke mbụ.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kedu echiche gị banyere nsonaazụ a?
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.0.after: 3:2 pụtara strawberry bụ ugboro 1.5 mmiri ara ehi, 6:5 bụkwa ugboro 1.2, ya mere oke ahụ gbanwere. Ịgbakwunye otu ọnụ ọgụgụ nwere ike ghara idobe oke.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ọ bụ ndaba, gbalịa otu usoro ahụ ọzọ
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Mgbe nsonaazụ dị ịtụnanya, ị nwere ike nyochaa usoro ahụ tupu ịta ụta maka ndaba.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Lelee ma oke strawberry na mmiri ara ehi, 3:2, ọ̀ gbanwere na 6:5.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ị jiri nsonaazụ ahụ dịka ihe ngosi iji lelee usoro.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Tinye mmiri ara ehi ọzọ iji dozie ụtọ ahụ
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Nsonaazụ ahụ agbadalarị n’akụkụ mmiri ara ehi, ya mere ịgbakwunye mmiri ara ehi ga-eme ka ọ dịkwuo njọ.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.1.info: Ọ mụbara strawberry okpukpu abụọ (iko 6), mụbakwa mmiri ara ehi okpukpu abụọ (iko 4), ụtọ ya wee bụrụ otu na nke mbụ.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ka ụtọ ya bụrụ otu na iko strawberry 9, iko mmiri ara ehi ole ka achọrọ?
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.1.after: Iko strawberry 3 ghọrọ 9, ugboro 3, ya mere iko mmiri ara ehi 2 ga-abụkwa ugboro 3, iko 6. 3:2 = 9:6.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.1.r.a: I mere strawberry ugboro 3, ya mere i mekwara mmiri ara ehi ugboro 3. Nke ahụ bụ echiche idobe oke 3:2.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Strawberry mụbara iko 6, ya mere i mụbara mmiri ara ehi iko 6. Ị na-eji echiche mbụ “tinye otu ọnụ ọgụgụ” ọzọ.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ị chepụtara ihe dị n’etiti strawberry na mmiri ara ehi. Ị leleghị ma 3:2 ka dị.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.2.info: Oge a ọ chọrọ iji iko strawberry 4.5. N’ịkpọ ọnụ ọgụgụ mmiri ara ehi □ iko, o dere nha nhata oke 3 : 2 = 4.5 : □.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Họrọ nha nhata ziri ezi iji chọta □.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.2.after: N’ime nha nhata oke, ngwaahịa ọnụọgụ mpụta abụọ hà na ngwaahịa ọnụọgụ ime abụọ. 3 × □ = 2 × 4.5, ya mere □ = 3.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ị gbanwere ọnụọgụ mpụta na ime mgbe ị na-amụba. Lelee ọzọ ọnụọgụ ndị jikọtara ọnụ n’ịmụba nke nha nhata oke.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Strawberry mụbara iko 1.5, ya mere ị gbakwunyere mmiri ara ehi iko 1.5 kwa. Ị laghachiri n’echiche mbụ.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ị jiri iwu na ngwaahịa ọnụọgụ mpụta hà na nke ọnụọgụ ime.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.reflect: Gịnị dị iche n’etiti oge mbụ i chere “tinye otu ọnụ ọgụgụ” na oge i dere nha nhata oke na njedebe? Nsonaazụ dị aṅaa mere ka ị gbanwee uche?
x-m-e6-07.s.s2.prompt: Gwa Suyeon nkenke ụzọ isi mekwuo mmiri ara ehi strawberry nke otu ụtọ.
x-m-e6-07.s.s2.hint.0: Jiri okwu gị kwuo strawberry ugboro ole ka i ji.
x-m-e6-07.s.s2.hint.1: Jiri nọmba ihe atụ nke usoro gị kọwaa.
x-m-e6-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị kwuru ọdịiche dị n’etiti usoro ịgbakwunye na usoro ịmụba?
x-m-e6-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: N’ihe atụ gị, a na-edobe oke 3:2 n’ezie?
x-m-e6-07.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na i mụbaa strawberry okpukpu abụọ, ị ga-amụbakwa mmiri ara ehi okpukpu abụọ. Dịka 3:2 → 6:4.
x-m-e6-07.s.s2.model.1: E kwesịghị ịgbakwunye; ị ga-amụba iji debe oke otu. Maka iko strawberry 9, mmiri ara ehi bụ iko 6.

x-m-e6-03.title: Concentrate karịrị pụtara ihe ọṅụṅụ siri ike karịa?
x-m-e6-03.goal: Gosi site n'ihe atụ megidere na nkwupụta “nke nwere concentrate karịa na-esi ike mgbe niile” anaghị adị mgbe niile, ma kọwaa ihe mere ị ga-eji tụnyere site n'iji ratio nke concentrate na ngụkọta niile.
x-m-e6-03.material: N'ụlọ ahịa ihe ọṅụṅụ, e mere ihe ọṅụṅụ abụọ site n'ịgwakọta concentrate na mmiri site n'iji otu iko. Ihe ọṅụṅụ A na-eji iko concentrate 3 na iko mmiri 5, ma ihe ọṅụṅụ B na-eji iko concentrate 4 na iko mmiri 8. Hajun kwuru, “B nwere concentrate karịa, iko 4, ya mere B siri ike karịa!” (N'ebe a, “siri ike karịa” pụtara na mgbe ị ṅụrụ otu ọnụọgụ, concentrate dị karịa n'ime ya.)
x-m-e6-03.thinking.0: Inyocha nkwupụta site n'iji ihe àmà
x-m-e6-03.thinking.2: Ichọta ma kọwaa ọkọlọtọ (ngụkọta niile) a ga-atụnyere
x-m-e6-03.prereq.0: Ihe ratio na rate pụtara (ọnụọgụ e tụnyere na ọnụọgụ ntọala)
x-m-e6-03.prereq.1: Ịtụnyere nha nke fractions site n'ọnụọgụ zuru ezu nwere otu na ọnụọgụ abụọ
x-m-e6-03.s.s1.prompt: Gịnị ka ị chere banyere ikpe Hajun?
x-m-e6-03.s.s1.hint.0: Ọ bụrụ na ị ṅụọ otu ọnụọgụ (dịka ọmụmaatụ, otu iko), concentrate ole dị n'ime ya?
x-m-e6-03.s.s1.hint.1: Lelee ma ngụkọta ọnụọgụ nke ihe ọṅụṅụ abụọ ahụ bụ otu.
x-m-e6-03.s.s1.o.a: Ọ bụ eziokwu. Ihe ọṅụṅụ nwere concentrate karịa na-esi ike mgbe niile
x-m-e6-03.s.s1.r.a: Ị lere naanị otu ihe, ọnụọgụ concentrate. Nwalee ma otu nsonaazụ ahụ na-adị mgbe ngụkọta ọnụọgụ agwakọtara dị iche.
x-m-e6-03.s.s1.o.b: Mba. Ị kwesịrị ịtụnyere ole n'ime ngụkọta ngwakọta bụ concentrate, ọ bụghị ọnụọgụ iko concentrate
x-m-e6-03.s.s1.r.b: Ị tọrọ ọkọlọtọ na-elele concentrate na ngụkọta ọnụọgụ ọnụ.
x-m-e6-03.s.s1.o.c: Mba. A pụrụ ikwu mgbe niile na ihe ọṅụṅụ nke etinyeghị mmiri dị ukwuu na-esi ike karịa
x-m-e6-03.s.s1.r.c: Ị lere naanị ọnụọgụ mmiri. Nsonaazụ dị ka ọ ziri ezi oge a, mana nwalee ya n'ọnụọgụ ndị ọzọ kwa.
x-m-e6-03.s.s1.explain: Otú ihe ọṅụṅụ si esi ike adịghị dabere naanị n'concentrate kamakwa na ole concentrate dị tụnyere ngwakọta niile. A nwere iko 3 n'ime iko 8 n'ozuzu, ma B nwere iko 4 n'ime iko 12 n'ozuzu.
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.prompt: Dị ka okwu Hajun si dị, mee ikpe 2 ebe ihe ọṅụṅụ A siri ike karịa ọbụna ma a tinyere concentrate karịa n'ihe ọṅụṅụ B, site n'iji ọnụọgụ dị iche n'ndị dị n'nsogbu ahụ (A: iko 3 na iko 5, B: iko 4 na iko 8). (Ọnụọgụ iko bụ ọnụọgụ eke na-adịghị karịa 20.)
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.hint.0: B chọrọ concentrate karịa, ya mere gịnị ga-eme ma ị tinyekwa mmiri dị ukwuu n'B?
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.hint.1: Maka ihe ọṅụṅụ ọ bụla, dee ole n'ime ngụkọta niile bụ concentrate dị ka nkewa ma ọ bụ fraction, ma tụnyere.
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Ọnụọgụ iko bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu site na 1 ruo 20.
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Ọnụọgụ iko ga-abụrịrị ọnụọgụ zuru ezu site na 1 ruo 20.
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Concentrate nke B ga-abụrịrị karịa concentrate nke A.
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.fail.c3: A adịghị siri ike karịa. Tụnyere ole concentrate dị n'ihe gbasara ngụkọta ọnụọgụ.
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.ok.c4: Ha dị iche n'ọnụọgụ dị n'nsogbu ahụ.
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Ndị a bụ kpọmkwem ọnụọgụ sitere n'nsogbu ahụ (3, 5, 4, 8). Nwaa ime ha site n'ọnụọgụ ndị ọzọ.
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.explain: Mee ndị ọhụrụ, ọ bụghị ọnụọgụ dị n'nsogbu ahụ. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ọ bụrụ na A nwere iko concentrate 2 na iko mmiri 2, 2/4=0.5, ma ọ bụrụ na B nwere iko concentrate 3 na iko mmiri 6, 3/9=ihe dị ka 0.333, ya mere A siri ike karịa ọbụna ma B nwere concentrate karịa. Iko 3 na iko 5 na iko 4 na iko 9 (3/8=0.375, 4/13=ihe dị ka 0.308) na-arụkwa ọrụ.
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Ịchọrọ ịgwa Hajun, “Nke ahụ abụghị eziokwu mgbe niile.” Kọwaa site n'iji ọnụọgụ dị n'ihe atụ ị mere.
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Nke mbụ kpebie ọnụọgụ ị ga-eji dị ka ihe atụ.
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Tinye n'okwu gị ihe ị kwesịrị ilele ya na “ọnụọgụ concentrate” ọnụ.
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.because.placeholder: Ọmụmaatụ: Ọ bụrụ na ị lee naanị concentrate, ...
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: N'ihe atụ gị, ọnụọgụ ndị ahụ ọ̀ na-egosi ihe mere A ji siri ike karịa?
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ kwuru na “nwere concentrate karịa” na “siri ike karịa” apụtaghị otu ihe?
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Ele naanị ọnụọgụ concentrate anya. Ị ga-elele ratio nke concentrate na ngụkọta ọnụọgụ; A bụ 3/8 ma B bụ 4/12, ya mere ihe ọṅụṅụ A siri ike karịa.
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.because.model.1: B nwere concentrate dị ukwuu, mana mmiri dị ukwuu kwa. A bụ iko 3 n'ime 8 ma B bụ iko 4 n'ime 12, ya mere mgbe ị tụnyere ratios, A siri ike karịa.

x-m-e6-04.title: Nke onye win rate dị elu karịa?
x-m-e6-04.goal: Mara na iji tụnyere win rates, ọnụọgụ mmeri anaghị ezu ma a chọrọ ngụkọta ọnụọgụ egwuregwu, ma chọta ọnụọgụ egwuregwu dị iche iche dabara n'ọnọdụ ndị ahụ.
x-m-e6-04.material: N'ogbako kickball, Class A emeriwo ugboro 12 ruo ugbu a ma Class B emeriwo ugboro 9. Seoyun kwuru, “Class A mere ugboro 3 karịa, ya mere Class A ka mma!” Win rate bụ ratio nke egwuregwu e meriri na egwuregwu niile e gbara.
x-m-e6-04.thinking.2: Ichọta ọtụtụ ụkpụrụ na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ
x-m-e6-04.prereq.0: Ihe rate pụtara, na idee rate dị ka fraction ma ọ bụ decimal
x-m-e6-04.prereq.1: Ịtụnyere nha nke ọnụọgụ zuru ezu
x-m-e6-04.s.s1.prompt: Iji mata nke klas win rate ya dị elu karịa, gịnị ka ị chọrọ ịmata ma e wezụga ọnụọgụ mmeri? Họrọ otu azịza kacha mma.
x-m-e6-04.s.s1.hint.0: Chee echiche ma mmeri 12 na 9 ka e gụrụ megide otu ntọala.

x-m-e6-04.s.s1.r.a: Nsonaazụ egwuregwu n'etiti abụọ bụ naanị akụkụ nke ngụkọta niile. A na-agbakọ win rate n'egwuregwu niile klas gbara.
x-m-e6-04.s.s1.o.b: Ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ n'klas abụọ ahụ
x-m-e6-04.s.s1.r.b: Ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ abụghị ọnụọgụ ntọala maka win rate. Chee echiche ọnụọgụ ọ bụla bụ ntọala maka win rate.
x-m-e6-04.s.s1.o.c: Ngụkọta ọnụọgụ egwuregwu Class A na Class B nke ọ bụla gbara
x-m-e6-04.s.s1.r.c: Ị hụrụ na a ga-atụnyere ọnụọgụ mmeri megide otu ntọala (ngụkọta ọnụọgụ egwuregwu).
x-m-e6-04.s.s1.o.d: Ọnụọgụ mfu nke Class A na Class B
x-m-e6-04.s.s1.r.d: Ị hụrụ na ịgbakwunye mmeri na mfu na-enye ngụkọta ọnụọgụ egwuregwu.
x-m-e6-04.s.s1.explain: Win rate na-atụnyere ọnụọgụ mmeri na ngụkọta ọnụọgụ egwuregwu, ya mere ịchọrọ ngụkọta ọnụọgụ egwuregwu. Ọ bụrụ na ị maara mfu, ị pụrụ ichọtakwa ngụkọta ọnụọgụ egwuregwu, ya mere ọ bụ otu ozi.
x-m-e6-04.s.s1.acc.0: Ọ bụrụ na ị maara mfu, ị pụrụ ịgbakwunye ha na mmeri ịnweta ngụkọta ọnụọgụ egwuregwu, ya mere nke ahụ zuru ezu ichọta win rate.
x-m-e6-04.s.s2.prompt: Class B meriri 9 n'egwuregwu 15 niile. Class A meriri ugboro 12. Ka win rate Class A dị elu karịa nke Class B, egwuregwu ole n'ozuzu ka Class A nwere ike igbo? Chọta ọnụọgụ egwuregwu 3 kwere omume.

x-m-e6-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Kọwaa site n'ịtụnyere win rates ihe mere ngụkọta egwuregwu 20 anaghị arụ ọrụ.

x-m-e6-08.s.s1.hint.1: Maka ahịrị nke ọ bụla, tụnyere radius i họọrọ na mbụ na ọnụọgụ i mụbara mgbe ị na-achọta mpaghara.

x-m-e6-08.s.s2.prompt: Ugbu a e dozila ngwọta Yuna, maka 24000원, pizza ole ka ukwuu: otu pizza ukwu ka ọ bụ pizza nta abụọ?

x-m-e6-08.s.s2.o.a: Otu pizza ukwu ka ukwuu. Nke a bụ n’ihi na mpaghara ya ji okpukpu 4.
x-m-e6-08.s.s2.r.a: Ị jiri mpaghara, ọ bụghị dayameta, dịka ntọala ntụnyere.

x-m-e6-08.s.s2.explain: Otu pizza nta bụ 78.5 cm² ma otu pizza ukwu bụ 314 cm², nke bụ okpukpu 4. Pizza nta abụọ bụ 157 cm², ya mere otu pizza ukwu na-enye ihe karịa.

x-m-e6-09.title: Ụzọ gbara okirikiri gburugburu ọdọ mmiri ahụ
x-m-e6-09.goal: Jiri ọdịiche nke mpaghara okirikiri abụọ chọta uru radiọs ndị ahụ site n'azụ gaa n'ihu, ma kọwaa na mpaghara nwere ike ịbụ otu n'agbanyeghị na obosara ụzọ ahụ dị iche.
x-m-e6-09.material: N'ogige otu, e nwere ọdọ mmiri gbara okirikiri, ụzọ gbara okirikiri nke obosara ya adịghị agbanwe gbara ya gburugburu. Mpaghara ụzọ ahụ bụ 75.36 m². Radiọs ọdọ mmiri r (m) na radiọs mpụta nke ụzọ R (m) abụọ bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu ma ha adịghị agafe 20 m (jiri 3.14 maka pi).
x-m-e6-09.thinking.0: Dee otu okwu ọtụtụ jiri ọdịiche nke mpaghara
x-m-e6-09.thinking.1: Chọta ọtụtụ azịza dabara n'ọnọdụ ndị ahụ
x-m-e6-09.thinking.2: Kọwaa mmekọrịta dị n'etiti obosara na mpaghara
x-m-e6-09.s.s1.prompt: Kedu okwu ọtụtụ na-egosi nke ọma mpaghara ụzọ gbara okirikiri ahụ?
x-m-e6-09.s.s1.hint.0: Chee okirikiri dum gụnyere ụzọ ahụ, na okirikiri ọdọ mmiri ahụ.
x-m-e6-09.s.s1.hint.1: Kedu ka ị ga-esi gosi mpaghara ụzọ ahụ naanị ya site n'iji mpaghara okirikiri abụọ ahụ?
x-m-e6-09.s.s1.r.a: I jiri obosara (R − r) dị ka radiọs. Ụzọ ahụ bụ akụkụ fọdụrụ mgbe ị wepụrụ okirikiri dị n'ime n'okirikiri dị n'èzí.
x-m-e6-09.s.s1.r.b: Ị chere na a ga-ewepụ mpaghara ọdọ mmiri n'ime mpaghara okirikiri dị n'èzí.
x-m-e6-09.s.s1.r.c: Nke a dị nso n'usoro maka gburugburu okirikiri. Maka mpaghara, a na-amụba radiọs ugboro abụọ.
x-m-e6-09.s.s1.explain: Mpaghara ụzọ = mpaghara okirikiri dị n'èzí − mpaghara ọdọ mmiri = 3.14 × R × R − 3.14 × r × r.
x-m-e6-09.s.s2.prompt: Chọta (R, r) 2 dị iche nke mpaghara ụzọ ya bụ 75.36 m². Ebe ọ bụ na e nwere ọdọ mmiri, r adịghị erughị 1.
x-m-e6-09.s.s2.hint.0: Iji wepụ 3.14 n'okwu ọtụtụ ahụ, gịnị ka ị nwere ike ime n'akụkụ abụọ ahụ?
x-m-e6-09.s.s2.hint.1: Gbanwee r otu otu ma lelee ihe R×R − r×r kwesịrị ịbụ.
x-m-e6-09.s.s2.ok.c1: R na r bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu n'ime oke ahụ.
x-m-e6-09.s.s2.fail.c1: R ga-abụrịrị ọnụọgụ zuru ezu na-agafeghị 20 ma r bụrụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu na-erughị 1.
x-m-e6-09.s.s2.fail.c2: Radiọs mpụta R ga-eburu ibu karịa radiọs ọdọ mmiri r.
x-m-e6-09.s.s2.explain: 75.36 ÷ 3.14 = 24, ya mere naanị ọnụọgụ zuru ezu nke R×R − r×r = 24 ka ị chọrọ. 7×7 − 5×5 = 24 na 5×5 − 1×1 = 24. Obosara ha bụ 2 m na 4 m, n'usoro.
x-m-e6-09.s.s2.because.prompt: N'azịza abụọ ahụ, obosara ụzọ ahụ dị iche ma mpaghara bụ otu. Kọwaa ihe mere nke a ji kwe omume.
x-m-e6-09.s.s2.because.hint.0: Chọta obosara (R − r) nke azịza abụọ ahụ ma tụnyere ha.
x-m-e6-09.s.s2.because.hint.1: Cheta ugboro ole a na-amụba radiọs mgbe a na-achọta mpaghara okirikiri.
x-m-e6-09.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ị mere ihe atụ ọzọ ebe obosara bụ otu ma mpaghara abụghị otu?
x-m-e6-09.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ị kwuru ihe mere mpaghara ji eto n'ụzọ dị iche maka ụzọ dị n'ime na ụzọ dị n'èzí?
x-m-e6-09.s.s2.because.model.0: A na-achọta mpaghara site n'ime radiọs square, ya mere ọbụna ma obosara bụ otu, mpaghara na-ebuwanye ibu ka ị na-aga n'èzí. Ya mere obosara dị iche nwere ike inye otu mpaghara.
x-m-e6-09.s.s2.because.model.1: Mpaghara okirikiri dabara na radiọs a mụbara ugboro abụọ, ya mere ọbụna ụzọ dị warawara (7−5=2 m) nwere ike inwe otu mpaghara dị ka ụzọ dị n'ime nke obosara ya bụ 4 m (5−1) ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị ncha n'èzí, n'ihi na mpaghara dị ukwuu n'ebe ahụ.

x-m-e6-01.s.s3.prompt: Dee azịza ziri ezi nke 3/4 ÷ 2/3, ma kọwaa n'ahịrịokwu otu ma ọ bụ abụọ ihe Minseo gbanwere n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi na ka o si mee.
x-m-e6-01.s.s3.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee ngwọta e rụzichara n'otu ahịrị.
x-m-e6-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ lelere azịza gị site n'ịmụba, kama naanị ịtụnyere ya na 2?
x-m-e6-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ kọwara n'okwu gị ihe mere “ịgbanwekwa dividend” ji bụrụ nsogbu?
x-m-e6-01.s.s3.model.0: 3/4 × 3/2 = 9/8 = 1 1/8. Naanị divisor 2/3 ka a gbanwere ka ọ bụrụ 3/2, mana Minseo gbanwekwara 3/4, ya mere ọ bụ njehie.
x-m-e6-01.s.s3.model.1: Naanị divisor ka a tụgharịrị, ya mere ọ na-aghọ 3/4 × 3/2 ma azịza bụ 9/8, ya bụ, 1 na 1/8. Minseo tụgharịrị ọnụọgụ mbụ kwa.
x-m-e6-01.s.s3.model.2: 3/4×3/2=9/8. Minseo ekwesịghị ịgbanwe dividend, mana ọ gbanwere ya.

x-m-e6-02.title: Ịkewa 12 mere ka ọ bụrụ nke ka ukwuu
x-m-e6-02.goal: Lelee, site n'iwu nkewa nke gị dabara n'ọnọdụ ndị ahụ, na ịkewa ọnụọgụ zuru ezu site na fraction erughị 1 na-enye quotient nke ka ukwuu karịa ọnụọgụ mbụ, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara.
x-m-e6-02.material: Jia kwuru, “Ịkewa na-eme ka ọnụọgụ pere mpe!” Ka anyị kewaa 12 site na fractions ụfọdụ ka anyị lelee ma nke a bụ eziokwu.
x-m-e6-02.thinking.0: Buru amụma ka nsonaazụ nkewa ga-adị ukwuu
x-m-e6-02.thinking.1: Ime ihe atụ na-emezu ọtụtụ ọnọdụ n'otu oge
x-m-e6-02.prereq.0: Mmekọrịta dị n'etiti fractions na ọnụọgụ zuru ezu; ihe fraction na-enweghị ike ibelata ọzọ pụtara (fraction n'ụdị kacha dị ala)
x-m-e6-02.prereq.1: Ahụmahụ nke ịtụle nkewa dị ka “ugboro ole ọ na-adaba n'ime”
x-m-e6-02.s.s1.prompt: Quotient nke 12 kewara site na 1/3 (otu ụzọ n'ime atọ) ọ̀ dị otu n'ime nke 12?
x-m-e6-02.s.s1.hint.0: Buru ụzọ chee echiche ugboro ole 1/3 na-adaba n'ime 1.
x-m-e6-02.s.s1.hint.1: Mgbe ahụ ugboro ole ka ọ ga-adaba n'ime 12?
x-m-e6-02.s.s1.o.a: Ọ na-aghọ pere mpe karịa 12. Ịkewa na-eme ka ọnụọgụ dị ntakịrị mgbe niile
x-m-e6-02.s.s1.r.a: Ị na-eji ahụmahụ gị nke ịkewa ọnụọgụ zuru ezu maka fractions dị ka ọ dị. Lelekwa ụdị ọnụọgụ divisor bụ.
x-m-e6-02.s.s1.o.b: Ọ na-aghọ ka ukwuu karịa 12. 1/3 na-adaba n'ime 12 karịa ugboro 12
x-m-e6-02.s.s1.r.b: Ị kọwara nkewa dị ka “ugboro ole ọ na-adaba n'ime.”
x-m-e6-02.s.s1.o.c: Ọ dị ka 12. Numerator bụ 1, ya mere ịdị ukwuu nke ọnụọgụ anaghị agbanwe
x-m-e6-02.s.s1.r.c: Ị lere naanị na numerator bụ 1. Chee echiche ọzọ ihe nkewa ahụ na-ajụ.
x-m-e6-02.s.s1.explain: 1/3 pere mpe karịa 1, ya mere 1/3 na-adaba n'ime 12 ugboro 36. Ya mere 12 ÷ 1/3 = 36, nke ka ukwuu karịa 12.
x-m-e6-02.s.s2.prompt: Ịchọrọ ikewa 12 site na proper fraction a/b (numerator a, denominator b). Mee fractions 3 dị iche nke enweghị ike ibelata ọzọ, nwere quotient nke bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu ma na-adịghị karịa 60.
x-m-e6-02.s.s2.hint.0: Nke mbụ lelee ọnụọgụ ole nwere ike ịbụ numerator, n'ihe gbasara 12.
x-m-e6-02.s.s2.hint.1: Họrọ numerator, wee gbanwee denominator ma lelee ma quotient bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu ma na-adịghị karịa 60.
x-m-e6-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Numerator na denominator bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu.
x-m-e6-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Numerator na denominator ga-abụrịrị ọnụọgụ zuru ezu nke bụ opekata mpe 1.
x-m-e6-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Ọ bụ proper fraction (numerator pere mpe karịa denominator).
x-m-e6-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Ọ bụghị proper fraction. Numerator ga-abụrịrị nke pere mpe karịa denominator.
x-m-e6-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Numerator na denominator nwere ihe nkesa ọnụ karịrị 1, ya mere a pụrụ ibelata ya.
x-m-e6-02.s.s2.explain: Dịka ọmụmaatụ, 12 ÷ 1/3 = 36, 12 ÷ 2/5 = 30, na 12 ÷ 3/4 = 16. Ka quotient bụrụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu, numerator ga-ekewa 12 n'enweghị ihe fọdụrụ.
x-m-e6-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Nkwupụta Jia “Ịkewa na-eme ka ọnụọgụ dị ntakịrị” anaghị adị n'nkewa ndị ị mere n'elu. Kọwaa ihe kpatara, na-elekwasị anya n'divisor.
x-m-e6-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Lelee ka fraction ị mere si tụnyere na 1.
x-m-e6-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Chee echiche ugboro ole fraction ahụ na-adaba n'ime 12.
x-m-e6-02.s.s2.because.placeholder: Ọmụmaatụ: N'ihi na divisor pere mpe karịa 1, ...
x-m-e6-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ jiri otu fraction ị mere dị ka ihe atụ kọwaa?
x-m-e6-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ chekwara ihe na-eme mgbe “divisor karịrị 1”?
x-m-e6-02.s.s2.because.model.0: N'ihi na divisor bụ fraction pere mpe karịa 1, ugboro ole ọ na-adaba n'ime 12 karịrị 12. Ya mere quotient na-aghọ nke ka ukwuu.
x-m-e6-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Mgbe ị kewara site na proper fraction 1/2, ị naghị ekewa 12 n'ọkara; ị na-agụ ugboro ole 1/2 na-adaba n'ime, ya mere ị na-enweta 24, nke bụ ọnụọgụ ka ukwuu.

x-m-e6-10.title: Ọ bụrụ na ị jikọta ọnụọgụ ọnụ nke otu abụọ, ọ̀ dị kpọmkwem n'etiti?
x-m-e6-10.goal: Jiri data kpee ikpe na e nwere ọnọdụ ndị a na-ekwesịghị ịchọta nkezi nke ọnụọgụ ọnụ naanị mgbe a na-achọta ọnụọgụ ọnụ zuru ezu nke otu abụọ nke nha dị iche jikọtara, ma mee ọnọdụ dị otú ahụ n'onwe gị.
x-m-e6-10.material: N'Ọkwa 5, Otu 가 nwere ụmụ akwụkwọ 20 ma Otu 나 nwere ụmụ akwụkwọ 40. Ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ debanyere aha n'klas ịfụ eriri mgbe akwụkwọ gasịrị bụ pasent 40 n'Otu 가 na pasent 30 n'Otu 나. Ị chọrọ ịchọta ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ debanyere aha n'etiti ụmụ akwụkwọ 60 niile nke otu abụọ ahụ jikọtara.
x-m-e6-10.thinking.0: Hazie ihe ị nwere ike ma ọ bụ na ị nweghị ike ikwu site na data
x-m-e6-10.thinking.1: Gbanwee ọnụọgụ ọnụ ka ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ mmadụ, jikọta ha, ma mgbe ahụ chọta ọnụọgụ ọnụ ọzọ
x-m-e6-10.prereq.0: Iji pasent gosi nha akụkụ ma e jiri ya tụnyere ihe dum
x-m-e6-10.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ nkwupụta niile ị nwere ike ịchọpụta site na data dị n'elu.
x-m-e6-10.s.s1.hint.0: Buru ụzọ gbanwee ndị debanyere aha n'otu ọ bụla ka ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ mmadụ.
x-m-e6-10.s.s1.hint.1: Gbakwunye ọnụọgụ ndị a gbanwere ma gosi ha ọzọ dị ka ọnụọgụ ọnụ nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 60.
x-m-e6-10.s.s1.o.a: Ọnụọgụ ndebanye aha nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 60 jikọtara bụ pasent 35, nke dị n'etiti pasent 40 na pasent 30
x-m-e6-10.s.s1.r.a: I kezie ọnụọgụ ọnụ abụọ ahụ dị ka ha dị. Mgbe otu abụọ ahụ nwere nha dị iche, ị nweghị ike ịkeziri ha n'otu ibu. Gbakọta ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ debanyere aha ma kewaa ya site na ngụkọta iji lelee.
x-m-e6-10.s.s1.o.b: Ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ n'Otu 가 debanyere aha n'klas ịfụ eriri bụ 8
x-m-e6-10.s.s1.r.b: I jiri ọnụọgụ ọnụ mụbaa ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ nke otu dum iji gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ mmadụ.
x-m-e6-10.s.s1.o.c: Ọnụọgụ ndebanye aha nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 60 jikọtara dị ala karịa pasent 30
x-m-e6-10.s.s1.r.c: Ọnụọgụ ọnụ jikọtara dị n'etiti ọnụọgụ ọnụ nke otu abụọ ahụ. Lelee site n'ịchọta ngụkọta ọnụọgụ ndị debanyere aha.
x-m-e6-10.s.s1.o.d: Ụmụ akwụkwọ debanyere aha n'Otu 나 karịrị nke Otu 가
x-m-e6-10.s.s1.r.d: Ọnụọgụ ọnụ dị elu n'Otu 가, ma i tụnyere ya mgbe i gbanwechara ya ka ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ.
x-m-e6-10.s.s1.o.e: Ọnụọgụ ndebanye aha nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 60 jikọtara dị ala karịa pasent 35
x-m-e6-10.s.s1.r.e: I gbanwere ọnụọgụ ọnụ ka ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ, gbakwunye ha, ma kewaa site na ngụkọta iji lelee.
x-m-e6-10.s.s1.explain: Pasent 40 nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 20 n'Otu 가 bụ 8, ma pasent 30 nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 40 n'Otu 나 bụ 12. Ọnụ, nke ahụ bụ 20 n'ime 60, ya mere 20÷60=ihe dị ka pasent 33.3. Ọ bụghị pasent 35; ọ dị elu karịa pasent 30 ma dị ala karịa pasent 35.
x-m-e6-10.s.s2.prompt: Mee ọnọdụ 2 ebe ọnụọgụ ndebanye aha Otu 가 dị elu karịa nke Otu 나, ma ọnụọgụ ndebanye aha nke otu abụọ jikọtara dị ala karịa etiti ọnụọgụ ọnụ abụọ ahụ. Otu ọ bụla nwere ụmụ akwụkwọ site na 5 ruo 60, ọnụọgụ ọnụ bụ pasent ọnụọgụ zuru ezu, ma ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ debanyere aha bụ ọnụọgụ eke. x-m-e6-10.s.s2.hint.0: Chọta ọnụọgụ ndị debanyere aha n'otu ọ bụla, gbakwunye ha, ma mgbe ahụ gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ ọnụ nke ngụkọta ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ.
x-m-e6-10.s.s2.hint.1: Chee echiche banyere ọnụọgụ ọnụ nke otu nke na-emetụta ọnụọgụ ọnụ jikọtara karị mgbe otu abụọ ahụ nwere ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ dị iche.

x-m-e6-10.s.s2.ok.c3: Ọnụọgụ ndị tinyere akwụkwọ n'otu ọ bụla bụ ọnụọgụ eke.

x-m-e6-10.s.s2.ok.c5: Ọnụọgụ ntinye akwụkwọ jikọtara dị ala karịa etiti ọnụọgụ abụọ ahụ.
x-m-e6-10.s.s2.fail.c5: Ọnụọgụ ntinye akwụkwọ jikọtara adịghị ala karịa etiti ọnụọgụ abụọ ahụ.
x-m-e6-10.s.s2.ok.c6: Ọnụọgụ ndị a dị iche na ndị dị n'ajụjụ ahụ.
x-m-e6-10.s.s2.fail.c6: Ọnụọgụ ndị a bụ kpọmkwem ndị dị n'ajụjụ ahụ. Mee ihe atụ gị jiri ọnụọgụ dị iche.
x-m-e6-10.s.s2.explain: Gbakwunye ọnụọgụ ndị tinyere akwụkwọ n'otu abụọ ahụ, ma mgbe ahụ kewaa site na ngụkọta ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ iji lelee. x-m-e6-10.s.s2.because.hint.0: Tụnyere ngụkọta ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ nke klas abụọ ahụ n'ihe atụ i mere.
x-m-e6-10.s.s2.because.hint.1: Jiri okwu nke gị kọwaa ọnụọgụ ole ka pasent bụ akụkụ ya.
x-m-e6-10.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ na-ahụ ọnụọgụ n'ihe atụ gị ebe ọnụọgụ jikọtara na etiti ọnụọgụ abụọ ahụ pụtara dị iche?
x-m-e6-10.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ị chere ihe ọnụọgụ jikọtara ga-abụ ma ọ bụrụ na otu abụọ ahụ nwere otu ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ?
x-m-e6-10.s.s2.because.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na otu abụọ ahụ nwere ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ dị iche, ọnụọgụ ha nwere ibu dị iche. Ọnụọgụ nke otu nwere ụmụ akwụkwọ ka ọtụtụ na-emetụta ọnụọgụ jikọtara karị, ya mere ị ga-agbakwunye ụmụ akwụkwọ niile tinyere akwụkwọ ma kewaa site na ngụkọta ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ.
x-m-e6-10.s.s2.because.model.1: Otu 가 nwere ụmụ akwụkwọ 20 ma Otu 나 nwere ụmụ akwụkwọ 40, ya mere ị nweghị ike ịkeziri ọnụọgụ ha dị ka a ga-asị na ha ruru otu. Ọ bụrụ na ị kewaa ụmụ akwụkwọ 20 ị nwetara site n'ịgbakwunye 8 na 12 tinyere akwụkwọ site na ngụkọta 60, ị ga-enweta ihe dị ka pasent 33.3.

x-m-e6-05.topic: Volume na surface area nke rectangular prism
x-m-e6-05.goal: Gosi site n'ihe atụ megidere na nkwupụta “rectangular prism nwere surface area buru ibu karịa nwere volume buru ibu karịa” anaghị adị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara site n'ijikọ ya na udi.
x-m-e6-05.material: Jimin na-arụ ọrụ ịkpuchi igbe rectangular n'ụlọ ahịa onyinye ma kwuru, “Igbe nke na-ewe akwụkwọ mkpuchi karịa (igbe nwere surface area buru ibu karịa) na-ejide ihe karịa (nwere volume buru ibu karịa)!” Ogologo, obosara, na ịdị elu dị n'cm ma niile bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu.
x-m-e6-05.thinking.1: Ịtụnyere ọnụọgụ abụọ (surface area na volume) ọnụ
x-m-e6-05.thinking.2: Ịkọwa mmekọrịta dị n'etiti udi na ọnụọgụ
x-m-e6-05.prereq.0: Ihe surface area na volume nke rectangular prism pụtara na otu esi achọta ha (Grade 6)
x-m-e6-05.prereq.1: Idee ogologo, obosara, na ịdị elu dị ka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu (cm)
x-m-e6-05.s.s1.prompt: Iji gosi na nkwupụta Jimin abụghị “mgbe niile” eziokwu, ụdị igbe ole ka ị kwesịrị ịchọ?
x-m-e6-05.s.s1.hint.0: Cheta na otu ihe atụ nwere ike ibu okwu “mgbe niile”.
x-m-e6-05.s.s1.hint.1: N’igbe abụọ ahụ, ihe abụọ ahụ ga-aga n’ụzọ megidere ibe ha.
x-m-e6-05.s.s1.o.a: Chọọ igbe abụọ ebe nke nwere elu ka ukwuu nwere olu pere mpe.
x-m-e6-05.s.s1.r.a: Ị maara na otu ihe atụ zuru ezu imebi “mgbe niile.”
x-m-e6-05.s.s1.o.b: Chọọ ọtụtụ ụzọ abụọ igbe ebe nke nwere elu ka ukwuu nwekwara olu ka ukwuu.
x-m-e6-05.s.s1.r.b: N’agbanyeghị ụzọ nwere otu nsonaazụ ole ị hụrụ, egosighị na “mgbe niile” ziri ezi. Ị chọrọ ihe atụ na-emegide nkwupụta ahụ.
x-m-e6-05.s.s1.o.c: Mee ka ogologo, obosara, na ịdị elu igbe abụọ ahụ bụrụ otu, tụnyere.
x-m-e6-05.s.s1.r.c: Ọ dịghị ihe a ga-atụnyere n’etiti igbe yiri onwe ha. Ị chọrọ igbe abụọ dị iche.
x-m-e6-05.s.s1.o.d: Mee otu igbe nwere elu kachasị ukwuu, chọta olu ya.
x-m-e6-05.s.s1.r.d: Ị gaghị amata ma ihe abụọ ahụ na-agakọ n’otu ụzọ site n’otu igbe. Ị ga-atụnyere igbe abụọ dị iche.
x-m-e6-05.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na “elu ka ukwuu pụtara olu ka ukwuu” bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, igbe dị otú ahụ agaghị adị. Ọ bụrụgodị na otu ụzọ dị, nkwupụta ahụ ezighị ezi.
x-m-e6-05.s.s2.prompt: Họrọ igbe P (ogologo a, obosara b, ịdị elu c) na igbe Q (ogologo d, obosara e, ịdị elu f) ka P nwee elu ka ukwuu ma olu P pere mpe, mepụta ụzọ ihe atụ dị iche 2. Ogologo niile bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu site na 1 ruo 20 cm.
x-m-e6-05.s.s2.hint.0: Gbalịa malite site n’ime P ka ọ bụrụ igbe dị ogologo ma dị gịrịgịrị, Q bụrụ igbe akụkụ ya hà nhata ihe dịka.
x-m-e6-05.s.s2.hint.1: Mgbe ọ bụla ịhọrọ igbe, gbakọọ elu ya na olu ya abụọ, tụnyere.
x-m-e6-05.s.s2.ok.c1: Ogologo niile bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu site na 1 ruo 20.
x-m-e6-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Ogologo niile ga-abụrịrị ọnụọgụ zuru ezu site na 1 ruo 20.
x-m-e6-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Elu P adịghị karịa nke Q.
x-m-e6-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Olu P adịghị obere karịa nke Q.
x-m-e6-05.s.s2.explain: Ọ bụrụ na P bụ 1×1×20, elu ya bụ 82 cm², olu ya bụ 20 cm³; ọ bụrụ na Q bụ 3×3×3, elu ya bụ 54 cm², olu ya bụ 27 cm³. 1×2×10 (elu 64, olu 20) na 2×3×4 (elu 52, olu 24) na-arụkwa ọrụ.
x-m-e6-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Jiri ọdịdị igbe kọwaa ihe mere igbe nwere ike inwe elu ka ukwuu ma olu pere mpe.
x-m-e6-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Jiri okwu kọwaa ọdịdị P na Q (dị ogologo ma dị gịrịgịrị, ma ọ bụ dị ka cube).
x-m-e6-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Lee ihu ma ọ bụ akụkụ ndị kacha emetụta elu na olu.
x-m-e6-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ị ji otu n’ime igbe i mere kọwaa ya dịka ihe atụ?
x-m-e6-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ị kewapụrụ ọdịdị ebe naanị elu na-abawanye na nke olu na-abawanyekwa?
x-m-e6-05.s.s2.because.model.0: 1×1×20 dị ogologo ma dị gịrịgịrị, ya mere elu ya bụ 82 ma olu ya bụ 20; 3×3×3 dị ka cube, elu ya bụ 54, olu ya bụ 27. Mgbe igbe dị ogologo ma dị gịrịgịrị, elu ya dị ọtụtụ ma ohere ime ya adịghị ukwuu.
x-m-e6-05.s.s2.because.model.1: Otu akụkụ naanị dị ogologo nke ukwuu, ndị ọzọ bụ 1, ya mere elu na-abawanye ma ime ya fọrọ nke nta ka ọ ghara ito. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, 1×1×20 nwere olu 20, 3×3×3 nwekwara 27.
x-m-e6-05.s.s2.because.model.2: P dị ogologo ma dị gịrịgịrị, nwere ọtụtụ ihu buru ibu, ya mere elu ya dị ukwuu; ma ịdị elu ya pere mpe, olu ya dịkwa obere. Q dị ka cube, ya mere olu ya dị ukwuu.
